svg.text: STAGE 457 · TOPIC 97 · SVG 101 · 🎉 HISTORIC 460-DIMENSION MILESTONE (P907–P908)
Enterprise SIP RFC 6140 GIN Bulk Trunk (;bnc) DID Scope & Path Guard
Eliminating Malformed user@;bnc Double-@ Crashes, Cross-Tenant E.164 DID Hijacking & Inbound NAT Blackholes
🎉 460 EVALUATION DIMENSIONS
917 Guards · 926 Probes · 899 Tests
❌ Unguarded RFC 6140 ;bnc: Double-@ Crash & Cross-Tenant Hijack
1. Non-Empty user@;bnc Syntax Crash & Cross-Tenant DID Hijack
• Gateway sends Contact: <sip:pbx@10.0.1.8;bnc> (violates RFC 6140 §5.1).
• Naive rewrite produces sip:+12065550199@pbx@10.0.1.8 → 100% 400 drops!
• Missing tenant DID ownership check lets Tenant A's ;bnc template
intercept inbound customer calls destined for Tenant B's E.164 DIDs!
Result: 100% Inbound Trunk Outage or Cross-Tenant Call Interception
2. Missing RFC 3327 Path Blackhole & Unjittered Refresh Storm
• Bulk ;bnc REGISTER omits Supported: path, gin & +sip.instance.
• Inbound DID INVITE bypasses edge SBC pinhole and hits private NAT IP.
• Synchronized 60s refresh across 500 trunks (500,000 DIDs) triggers
a 16,666 msg/s registration thundering herd & radix-tree lock stall!
Result: Inbound DID NAT Blackholes & Registrar Database Lockup
✅ RFC 6140 ;bnc DID Scope Guard (P907) & Path/Refresh Guard (P908)
P907 · RFC 6140 Userless ;bnc Syntax, Tenant DID & [10, 10000] Guard
• Strictly enforces empty user@ part on all ;bnc Contact headers.
• Verifies dialed E.164 DID ownership against authenticated trunk AOR.
• Clamps bulk DID capacity per ;bnc trunk registration to [10, 10000].
• 100% eliminates double-@ URI crashes & cross-tenant DID hijacks!
clampedMalformedBncOrCrossTenantDidHijackCalls = 0 · DIDs ∈ [10, 10000]
P908 · RFC 6140 Path/+sip.instance Binding & [600, 3600]s Refresh Guard
• Enforces Supported: path, gin & +sip.instance edge-tunnel binding.
• Routes 100% of inbound rewritten DID calls through edge SBC pinhole.
• Clamps bulk trunk registration Expires to [600, 3600]s (1800s nominal)
with randomized jitter — cuts registration load by 99.9%!
clampedMissingPathBlackholeOrThunderingHerdRegistrations = 0 · Expires ∈ [600, 3600]s
